title: Four pilots killed after two Philippine Air Force trainer planes crash
paragraphs: Four pilots killed after two Philippine Air Force trainer planes crash
The aviation accident on Friday (Oct 23) involved two SF-260 aircraft during a training flight at the Fernando Air Base in Batangas province, the Philippine Air Force said in a statement.
MANILA: Two Philippine Air Force trainer aircraft crashed during a training flight at an air base south of the capital Manila, killing four pilots, the military said on Saturday (Oct 24).
